sources: https://book.wvstateparks.com/Ecomm/Listings/SupplierTile/7816932/en-US?supplierId=7975381 and ?supplierId=11067283 (stays 2026-10-27 to 2027-06-20, unit names, prices and unit-amenity tags, read 2026-10-21 with audit/state_park_fees/wv_tiles.py)

values.note: Booking site, May-June 2027, weeknights and a Friday-Saturday stay alike: non-electric sites $34.99 a night (several tagged as fitting a 20-30 ft RV), electric sites $42.99, a few $44.99. Nothing was offered for late October 2026.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 7975381 'Audra State Park Non-electric Campsites' ($34.99 on 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-18/20) + supplier 11067283 'Audra State Park Electric Campsites' ($42.99 / $44.99), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday: the booking site sold one-night Tuesday stays in May and June 2027 and offered nothing for a one-night Friday or Saturday.

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/audra-state-park/lodging/camping-at-audra-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one-night Sunday through Thursday.'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay.') + book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 7975381/11067283 (one night 2027-06-18 and 2027-06-19: none), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'open spring throughout the fall, weather permitting' (no dates); the booking site offered no sites for 2026-10-27.

hookups.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/audra-state-park/lodging/camping-at-audra-state-park/ ('65 scenic camp sites – 39 of which have electricity') + book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067283 (electric sites tagged 20/30 Amp, three also 50 Amp; none tagged Water or Sewage Hookup), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 65 sites, 39 with electricity. The booking site tags about 20 sites riverfront, two pull-through, and gives no RV-length class above '20’ to 30’ RV'.

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/audra-state-park/lodging/camping-at-audra-state-park/ ('Choose from 65 scenic camp sites – 39 of which have electricity') + book.wvstateparks.com unit-amenity tags (Riverfront, Pull Thru Site, RV-length classes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Two bathhouses with modern facilities; coin-operated washers and dryers; 'a dumping station is located nearby'. Store sells camping supplies, ice and firewood.

facilities.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/audra-state-park/lodging/camping-at-audra-state-park/ ('two bathhouses with modern facilities'; 'Coin-operated washing machines and dryers are available on-site and a dumping station is located nearby'; 'The campground store is stocked with camping supplies'), read 2026-10-21

note: Small riverfront RV campsites.  Can be crowded and noisy on weekends.  Sites can be flooded after rain.  --AWH
summary: Park page + booking site: fees $34.99 non-electric (+$8 electric) confirmed; inherited booking rules (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max) confirmed into the entry; added 50-amp, 65 sites with two pull-throughs, laundry, store, spring-fall season. Note: dropped AWH's 'from $35+tax' (now in fees).
